mechanics.mechanic: Atomic, checksummed, versioned saves with backup recovery
mechanics.evidence: WorldTest save round trip, corruption and tamper tests

mechanics.mechanic: Only a valid main save is rotated into the backup; a damaged main is moved aside as `.corrupt-*`
Crash recovery: a complete temp save (newest attempt), then main, then backup; partial or corrupt copies are never chosen; directory fsync where the platform allows
A save from a newer game version is reported unsupported, never renamed, downgraded to an older backup or overwritten (saving is refused)
Unknown nature/gender/status/Mint values become Hardy/genderless/healthy/none with a warning; other type errors still fail
v1, v2, v3 and v4 golden fixtures in the historical schemas load through the migration chain; a v4 save is Unsupported for code that knows v3
v3 -> v4 migration (link trades): trade journal and original met level added as null; nothing rewritten

Link trade journal: PREPARED saved before the swap; swap and COMMITTED in one atomic save; both survive a load (the player is told) and are resolved only by a link with the same partner (name and trainer id): PREPARED completes against COMMITTED, cancels against PREPARED or no journal; COMMITTED clears against COMMITTED or no journal and waits for the partner's COMMITTED against PREPARED
mechanics.evidence: TradeTransactionTest (cut at every message index, reset, silent and one-way, then a restart of neither, either or both devices and a reconnect: always the whole trade or none; also a cut at every message of the reconnect or a failed save in it, then a clean link); TradeKillTest (SIGKILL during the save); SaveAtomicityTest (a save that throws leaves the old state on disk); run_link_scene.sh resume
mechanics.note: A save rolled back to its backup or overwritten by a new game can still leave a trade one-sided

mechanics.mechanic: Open trade journal locks: the given Pokémon cannot be released, deposited, traded or given to an in-game trade (it can battle and level); a link trade with another partner is refused until the journal is resolved; link battles are not affected. Manual way out in the LINK menu (UNFINISHED TRADE) with a warning naming what can be lost
mechanics.evidence: TradeJournalLockTest (each lock, both journal states of the manual way out)

mechanics.mechanic: v1 -> v2 migration (Pokédex forms, nickname offers, unique ids); no rerolls on load
v2 -> v3 migration (obedience): outsider flag added as false; saved met levels kept; a missing met level becomes the current level; a met level above the current level is repaired
Interrupted capture resumes at the nickname prompt

Rule presets: levels as they are, flat 50, three against three (each player picks three after seeing both teams; picks are committed, then revealed, then the seed; the battle uses them in the order picked)
mechanics.evidence: LinkPickTest (30 lockstep battles, picks not sent before both commitments, a reveal that does not match voids); LobbySessionTest presets; run_link_scene.sh discovery
mechanics.note: 3 VS 3 needs three Pokémon on both sides

mechanics.mechanic: Lost link in a started link battle: paused for 20 s while the host listens again and the guest reconnects; the guest proves the session first (token from both seed commitments), each side repeats the frames the other missed, the battle goes on at the same point with the per-point state hash check; after 20 s it is void; nothing is saved either way
mechanics.evidence: LinkReconnectTest (resumed battles end with the same hash as without the cut; grace period runs out; a stranger is dropped); LockstepBattleTest silence
mechanics.note: Before the battle starts a lost link still voids at once

mechanics.mechanic: Host discovery on the local network: UDP broadcast announcements and queries (`java.net`, no multicast, no extra Android permission); the typed code stays as the fallback
